verses.text: On my bed at night I sought the one I love; I sought him, but did not find him.

xrefs.text: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
I opened for my beloved, but he had turned and gone. My heart sank at his departure. I sought him but did not find him. I called, but he did not answer.
Tell me, O one I love, where do you pasture your sheep? Where do you rest them at midday? Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your companions?
My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

verses.text: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.

xrefs.text: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour? He asked Peter.

verses.text: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”

xrefs.text: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city. They beat me and bruised me; they took away my cloak, those guardians of the walls.
“Woman, why are you weeping? Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking? Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.
For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
This is the burden against Dumah: One calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”
“Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,

verses.text: I had just passed them when I found the one I love. I held him and would not let go until I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the chamber of the one who conceived me.

xrefs.text: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
Hold on to instruction; do not let go. Guard it, for it is your life.
Before I realized it, my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people.
I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

verses.text: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.

And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”

verses.text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?

xrefs.text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? I roused you under the apple tree; there your mother conceived you; there she travailed and brought you forth.
My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
His cheeks are like beds of spice, towers of perfume. His lips are like lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh.

verses.text: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty of the mightiest men of Israel.

xrefs.text: And he will take your menservants and maidservants and your best cattle and donkeys and put them to his own use.
King Solomon has made his carriage out of the timber of Lebanon.
David replied, “Then you will come to know what your servant can do.” “Very well,” said Achish. “I will make you my bodyguard for life.”

Then Elisha prayed, “O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.” And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

verses.text: All are skilled with the sword, experienced in warfare. Each has his sword at his side prepared for the terror of the night.

xrefs.text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.

Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth— to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.

verses.text: He has made its posts of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple fabric. Its interior is inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem.

verses.text: Come out, O daughters of Zion, and gaze at King Solomon, wearing the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding— the day of his heart’s rejoicing.

xrefs.text: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
“Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him— even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
